basics.name: Dan McNamara
basics.label: Emmy Award-winning engineering manager and full-stack engineer
basics.summary: Engineering leader and developer who still likes getting into the code. I've grown and run remote teams of 15+ across development, DevOps, QA and data science, led platform migrations and AI-driven data ingestion work in community solar, and earlier helped build Emmy Award-winning production software for film and TV.

work.name: Perch Energy
work.summary: Joined via Perch's acquisition of Solstice.
highlights: Led a high-stakes data migration to the Salesforce-based Perch platform under a 6-month deadline, taking a hands-on role writing most of the migration using dbt with AI tooling; navigated significant ambiguity and a lack of existing documentation to reverse-engineer complex data models and business rules and deliver the project on time and under budget.
Enabled significant consolidation and cost savings.

work.name: Solstice Power Technologies
highlights: Led all of the engineering org, focused on Solstice's web-based platform for community solar enrollment, servicing, invoicing, and analytics; established technical vision and product roadmaps.
Managed a fully remote team of 15+, including developers, DevOps engineers, QA engineers, data scientists, and occasionally product managers.
Grew Engineering team from 4 engineers, owning hiring, organization design, and team development with a 98% retention rate.
Embraced CI/CD architecture: built roadmap to guide team through transition from manual build and QA process to automated testing and deploy, including training and workflow automations.
Optimized team structure to meet business needs: implemented systems and managed migration to pod structure to prevent emergent work from derailing long term goals.
Led migration from separate repos to an NX monorepo, reducing code duplication, removing a major source of defects, and improving developer efficiency.
Prototyped and led development of an automated pricing engine integrated with Salesforce QPC, reducing time to price by 50% and ensuring a consistent margin.

Introduced AI coding tools and led a hackathon that yielded an LLM-based utility data ingestion system for 15 territories; fully integrated within a month, this increased data accuracy by 40% and reduced projected QC headcount by 10.

work.name: Solstice Power Technologies
highlights: Managed Engineering, Product, and Design teams to deliver high impact features.
Revamped company OKR process, using a laddering OKR framework to streamline goal-setting.
Led sprints, managed releases, planned and communicated company objectives to teams.
Built spec and tech design for operating EnergyScore, an equity-focused ML alternative to FICO. Analyzed compliance needs against FCRA and GLBA regulations and designed API/front-end.
Rebuilt an agile sprint framework for the engineering team and implemented cross functional sprint review and roadmaps to better convey platform progress to members of other teams.
Improved security posture: implemented external penetration tests, managed mitigations. Built developer security training including OWASP Standards.

work.name: SyncOnSet Technologies
highlights: Worked with Product Management and other stakeholders to break down specs, make estimates, and negotiate features and timelines.
Mentored and coached junior engineers, successfully elevating ICs into Tech Lead roles.
Engineering lead for Asset Hub, a physical asset tracking and management platform for film studios, from inception through launch, and to adoption by many major Hollywood studios.
Chose technologies (Angular2, TypeScript, Redux, Jasmine, Express) for initial build.
Led planning, architecture, and development. Managed timelines and deliverables.

work.name: SyncOnSet Technologies
highlights: Contributed to development of SyncOnSet Crew Tools, an Emmy Award-winning continuity and inventory tracking software suite for film production.
